title: Distinguish committed event history from uncommitted record changes
preconditions: Commit one record with reason A, revise it and commit reason B; keep known commit hashes and parent boundaries.

steps.expected_result: Both authored changes have their commit reasons; uncommitted is false.

steps.action: Make an uncommitted revision through the public authoring command and query history again.
steps.expected_result: Committed events and reasons are unchanged; uncommitted is true.

steps.action: Inspect each committed event with a resolvable prior boundary.
steps.expected_result: Every open command names the correct against and head for its change.
